stock_segments.discussion_summary: Acast delivered solid Q3 with revenue +12% and EBITDA margin turning positive at +3%. The turnaround is working with gross margin at 40% (above 35-38% target). Key concern: no listener growth - iOS update effect of 10-15% decline, but this has been offset by higher monetization (43 öre per listener vs 33 öre year ago, +30%). Company is adding more ad breaks in podcasts to boost revenue, but hosts worry this may alienate listeners. Financial targets: aiming for 40-45% organic growth 2020-2025, positive EBITDA for 2024. Valuation is tricky: EV/EBITDA ~100 for 2024 but could drop to 10-15 if 10% margins achieved. Long-term EBITDA margin potential 8-15%.

stock_segments.discussion_summary: Nelly executing successful turnaround from broken retail to profitable growth. Down 20% revenue in 2023 (clearing bad customers) but now turning positive: Q4 2024 Q1 +1.4%. Massive margin improvement: gross 40% → 55%, operating -4% → +10.5%. Strategy: fewer discounts, more own brands (45% of sales), focus on bestsellers to reduce inventory and returns. Return rate improved 34% → 27%. New IT systems being implemented (costly but nearing completion). Trading at P/E 12-13, potential 15. EBIT-FCF 8-10. Excellent transparency - reports all key metrics upfront. Stock up ~90% since early 2024. Still some upside but easy money may be done.

quotes.speaker: Unknown
quotes.text: De har ju lyckats med sin turnaround. Man har ju rensat kunder, precis som på Chefello. Man vill ju inte ha de dåliga kunderna längre.

quotes.speaker: Unknown
quotes.text: Tittar man tillbaks då för två år sedan, alltså Q3 2022, då var bruttomarginalen precis över 40% och nu är man uppe på 55% i Q3. Rörelsemarginalen har gått från minus 4% till dagens 10,5. Så det är en enorm lönsamhetsförbättring man gjort de senaste två åren.

quotes.speaker: Unknown
quotes.text: För i princip alla de intressanta posterna redovisas ju väldigt upfront. Det är ju extremt lite gissningsarbete tycker jag med de här rapporterna.

quotes.speaker: Unknown
quotes.text: Nu rätter ner 27% ungefär i Q3 jämfört med 34% förrgående år. Lagrantering och distributionskostnader ligger på 12% av omsättningen jämfört med 14% tidigare år.

quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.speaker: Unknown
quotes.text: Jag vet inte vad det här borde vara värt, men det känns som kanske P15 i alla fall. Inte orimligt. Ett bolag som börjar växa lite grann igen.

summary: Episode discusses Trump election victory and Elon Musk's impact, then analyzes several company reports. Main themes: retail turnarounds (Nelly successful, Chefello struggling with growth), Acast profitability progress but no listener growth, Gimv gaming peripherals recovery. Key insight: profitability improvements need revenue growth for sustained valuation increases.
key_takeaways: Elon Musk's Twitter acquisition significantly impacted election by changing what users see
Acast profitable but no listener growth - monetization only can't drive long-term value
Nelly successful turnaround through margin expansion, now showing revenue growth
Chefello struggling to grow active customer base despite profitability
Gimv gaming peripherals recovering with new T598 product launch
Kurdistan pipeline news creates opportunity but deal terms uncertain
